title: GEMSDOE35 — Fault-Discovery Experiments & Space-Filling Design
description: DOE GEMS Prize experiments repository that adds a formal space-filling (Latin hypercube) design so duplicate candidates are avoided at the design stage instead of being caught after generation. It preserves its charter and prompt verbatim and keeps a hypothesis register, an AGENTS.md protocol and a machine-readable latest experiment report. Its charter states that a local proxy result must never be turned into an unearned competition score claim.
